coverage_scope: All substantive m82630 choices are logged; the wider 82-component Tamil A10 assignment remains partial.
authoring_disclosure: All rationales below are retrospective reconstructions of the recovered draft, independently rechecked on 2026-09-04; none is presented as contemporaneous intent or expert certification.

entries.source_sense: algebra as the mathematical subject; Elementary Algebra and Prealgebra as book/course titles
authorities_checked: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, m82630, commit 38cae454e644abf9f0a623e876994553881597c9: source sense checked.

Government of Tamil Nadu / SCERT Class 6 Term 1 Mathematics (2018), school-hosted copy https://www.kulikaraighss.in/books/6t1all/6t1maths.pdf, SHA-256 277fd1e9c72c129d02448c237fa7b106bfd50ba97ac4dce8f117e404321eb618, rendered PDF page 5: visibly prints ‘இயற்கணிதம் - ஓர் அறிமுகம்’.
entries.rationale: The school canon directly attests இயற்கணிதம். Descriptive Tamil distinguishes the two English book titles without pretending they are official localized titles.
entries.uncertainty: Low for இயற்கணிதம்; moderate for the descriptive rendering of the branded title Prealgebra.
entries.review_question: Does ‘இயற்கணிதத்திற்கு முன்’ read naturally as a descriptive book title across Tamil-medium Grades 6-8, or should the English title remain beside it?

entries.source_sense: whole numbers include zero; integers also include negative whole-number values
authorities_checked: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, m82630, commit 38cae454e644abf9f0a623e876994553881597c9: Chapter 1 source distinction checked.

Government of Tamil Nadu / SCERT Class 6 Term 1 Mathematics (2018), same verified PDF, rendered page 35 / printed page 29 and rendered page 175 / printed page 169: page 35 defines இயல் எண்கள் from 1 and முழு எண்கள் by adjoining 0; page 175 pairs Whole Numbers with முழு எண்கள் and Integers with முழுக்கள்.
entries.rationale: The two attested Tamil terms preserve the source's set distinction. Explicit sequences in the authored orientation prevent the common ambiguity caused by using one phrase for both sets.
alternatives: இயல் எண்கள் / முழு எண்கள் (maps natural versus whole, not whole versus integer)
entries.uncertainty: Low for the mathematical mapping in this packet.
entries.review_question: Would a Tamil-medium learner in Grades 2-4 need an additional pictorial number-line cue when முழுக்கள் first appears in m82451?

entries.source_sense: equation, variable, and a system of equations
authorities_checked: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, m82630, commit 38cae454e644abf9f0a623e876994553881597c9: source concepts checked.
Government of Tamil Nadu / SCERT Class 6 Term 1 Mathematics (2018), same verified PDF, rendered page 175 / printed page 169: visibly pairs Equation with சமன்பாடு and Variables with மாறிகள்.
entries.rationale: The directly attested school terms anchor the compounds; தொகுப்பு keeps the sense of multiple equations considered together.
alternatives: மாறிலி for variable (rejected here because மாறிலி is used for constant)
entries.uncertainty: Low for சமன்பாடு and மாறிகள்; moderate for regional preference between தொகுப்பு and அமைப்பு in later systems units.
entries.review_question: For a later full systems lesson, is சமன்பாட்டுத் தொகுப்பு the clearest Tamil-medium school compound across Grades 7-8?

entries.source_sense: intersecting, parallel, and coincident lines; one, zero, and infinitely many system solutions
entries.chosen_wording: வெட்டும் நேர்கோடுகள்; இணை நேர்கோடுகள்; ஒன்றின்மேல் ஒன்று பொருந்தும் நேர்கோடுகள்
authorities_checked: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, m82630 and canonical JPEG, commit 38cae454e644abf9f0a623e876994553881597c9: source sense and exact bitmap checked.

Government of Tamil Nadu / SCERT Class 6 Term 1 Mathematics (2018), same verified PDF, rendered page 175 / printed page 169: visibly pairs Parallel lines with இணை கோடுகள் and Intersecting lines with வெட்டும் கோடுகள்.

Canonical JPEG media/CNX_ElemAlg_Figure_05_01_015_img.jpg, SHA-256 34fd0299880bc134f6308adcb2296ec1e145431909a1ab1cc2b507e01e3670f4, 791 x 257 visual inspection: contains only Intersecting, Parallel, and Coincident; no sentence-level captions.
entries.rationale: The attested line terms are extended with நேர்கோடுகள் for this graph. Coincident is explained descriptively because no selected canon page attests a stable compound. The corrected alt identifies actual English labels before separately giving the mathematical interpretation.
entries.uncertainty: Low for இணை and வெட்டும்; moderate for the intentionally descriptive coincident-lines wording.
entries.review_question: Which concise Tamil-medium term for coincident lines is most widely understood in Grades 7-8 without losing the idea that every point is shared?

entries.source_sense: integer exponents, including negative integer exponents
authorities_checked: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, m82630, commit 38cae454e644abf9f0a623e876994553881597c9: source phrase checked.

Government of Tamil Nadu / SCERT Class 6 Term 1 Mathematics (2018), same verified PDF, rendered pages 35 and 175: attest the number-set distinction and முழுக்கள், but do not attest the full compound ‘integer exponents’.
entries.rationale: This phrasing says that the exponent values are integers and avoids the ambiguous முழு எண் அடுக்குகள், which could be read as nonnegative whole-number exponents.
entries.uncertainty: Moderate; the selected school pages do not attest the complete advanced compound.
entries.review_question: What is the standard Tamil-medium rendering of ‘integer exponents’ in secondary-school algebra texts that explicitly includes negative exponents?

entries.source_sense: rectangular coordinate system, slope-intercept form, polynomial, rational expression, radical, and rational exponent
entries.chosen_wording: செங்குத்தாய அச்சுத்தொகுப்பு; சாய்வு-வெட்டு வடிவம்; பல்லுறுப்புக்கோவை; விகிதமுறு கோவை; மூலக்குறி; விகிதமுறு அடுக்கு
authorities_checked: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, m82630, commit 38cae454e644abf9f0a623e876994553881597c9: distinctions in the chapter map checked.

Government of Tamil Nadu / SCERT Class 6 Term 1 Mathematics (2018), same verified PDF, rendered page 175 / printed page 169: attests இயற்கணிதக் கோவைகள் and பின்னங்கள்; these complete advanced compounds were not found in the selected pages.
entries.rationale: Consistent Tamil mathematical compounds preserve the distinctions in the chapter map; none is misrepresented as a quotation from the selected Class 6 pages.
entries.uncertainty: Moderate to high because later-grade Tamil canon was not checked for these compounds in this bounded preface packet.
entries.review_question: Which of these advanced compounds should be normalized to later-grade Tamil Nadu textbook terminology before the corresponding source modules are translated?

entries.source_sense: answers versus worked solutions and the access split between student answer key and instructor-only guide
entries.chosen_wording: விடை / தீர்வு; மாணவர் விடைத்தொகுப்பு / ஆசிரியர்களுக்கான விடை வழிகாட்டி
authorities_checked: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, m82630, commit 38cae454e644abf9f0a623e876994553881597c9: exact answer-access policy checked.
Selected Tamil canon rendered pages 5, 35, and 175: the exact answer/solution policy compound was not found; no unsupported canon attribution is made.
entries.rationale: விடை names the response supplied to a question, while தீர்வு carries the problem-solving/result sense. The translation retains the source's instructor-access restriction without making it a condition for using this packet.
entries.uncertainty: Moderate lexical uncertainty; low uncertainty about the preserved access distinction.
entries.review_question: Is விடைத்தொகுப்பு the clearest learner-facing label for Answer Key across Grades 5-8, while keeping தீர்வு for worked mathematical solution?
